column1: # Stage-5 admission probe 1 (Part F.2): ZH negator selection.
# Columns: affirmative <TAB> attested-negative <TAB> expected negator <TAB> configuration
# The bundle rule under test: 没 iff the affirmative's aspect bundle is
# bounded/perfect/experiential, or the predicate is 有; 不 elsewhere.
# Novel rows: the "negative" column holds an A-not-A question and the
# expected column the negator embedded in it — configurations the
# parser has never handled, predicted by the same rule.
# Instrument corrections during the first run (configurations kept,
# items moved inside the parser's vocabulary): the 是+NP copula item
# was replaced by an adjective-state item (ZH nominal copula is
# unbuilt — a separate gap; 不 with 是 is categorical anyway), and
# the 会-modal item was dropped (modal 会 unbuilt; 想 covers the
# volitional configuration). Lexicon additions the probe required
# （有/看/喝/喜欢 verbs, 茶/猫 nouns, 高 adjective) are in sentence.ts.
